A North American cable operator — Telecom, Media & Entertainment engagement delivered by a 13-person team over 10 months, US scope, commercial model: build-run.

items: IVR containment metric masked unresolved contacts; repeat contact climbing.
Agents lacked account context at escalation; transfers stripped history.

blocks.x: We rebuilt conversational care: grounded voice/chat agents resolving top ten intents end-to-end, emotion-aware escalation with full context handoff, agent-assist summarization, and resolution analytics steering staffing. Compliance (consent, disclosure, retention) automated in the flow.
The engagement was structured for transfer: named pod, documented runbooks, operator enablement, and a Compound phase that keeps challenger programs and conformance monitoring running after handover.

items: Claims triage in minutes — 55% faster cycle times with document intelligence
Retention +4.1 points in target cohorts — early-warning to advising loop
